title: Decide whether to build the proposed product change

context.decision: State the choice this record must support
affected_people: Describe each affected role or group

target_user.context: Describe when the need becomes active
target_user.desired_progress: Describe the outcome the user seeks

problem.statement: State the user problem without embedding a solution
problem.current_behavior: Describe what the user does now

evidence.claim: State one precise finding or working assumption
evidence.source: Owner brief or another exact source
limitations: This item has not yet been verified with direct user evidence

options.name: Option A
options.mechanism: Explain how the option changes the user outcome
options.responsibility: Describe trust, access, accessibility, privacy, and harm concerns
options.failure_condition: State what would make this option fail

options.name: Keep current behavior
options.mechanism: Make no product change while gathering named evidence
options.responsibility: Describe the cost and risk of leaving the problem unchanged
options.failure_condition: State what would make waiting unacceptable

experiment.decision_enabled: State the decision this result will enable
experiment.question: State the uncertainty this test addresses
experiment.prototype: Describe what participants or systems will experience
experiment.participants_or_source: Describe who or what provides evidence
experiment.supporting_signal: State observable evidence that supports the hypothesis
experiment.challenging_signal: State observable evidence that challenges it
experiment.threshold: State the evidence bar set before the test
experiment.stop_rule: State when enough evidence has been collected
intentional_omissions: List what this experiment does not prove
controls: List required consent, privacy, safety, authorization, or rollback controls

next_step.completion_signal: Evidence is recorded and a decision is made
